 LIVE Updated 38 mins ago Leicester City 3-0 Wigan recap as Russell Martin's men make it three wins in four
 LeicestershireLive bring you LIVE coverage of Leicester City's League One encounter against Wigan Athletic
 Leicester City vs Wigan 
 Add to preferred sources Comments Sport Josh Holland Leicester City correspondent Updated 22:51, 27 Oct 2026 Leicester City recovered from Saturday's defeat to Luton Town by earning a comfortable 3-0 victory over Wigan Athletic on Tuesday night.
 Emil Riis' brace either side of half-time, his sixth and seventh goals for the club in all competitions, put City in cruise control before Bobby De Cordova-Reid converted a late penalty.
 The Foxes ' third win in four games moves Russell Marin's men up to 11th in the League One table and just three points off the play-offs.
 Stay tuned for build-up and live match coverage from our City correspondent, Josh Holland. 
 New Updates Key Events
 Full-time View Post Today 21:37 GMT Full-time
 3-0 win and it's a perfect night for City.
 Emil Riis' brace and Bobby Reid's penalty does the job to make it three wins in four games.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 21:34 GMT 3-0!
 3-0 and Bobby Reid gets his goal!
 Comments Josh Holland Today 21:32 GMT PENALTY CITY
 Harry Souttar goes down and it's a penalty!
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 21:25 GMT Last changes
 Bobby De Cordova-Reid comes on for Emil Riis and gets a standing ovation.
 Ilari Kangasniemi is also on, replacing Louis Page.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 21:18 GMT Third change
 Will Alves come off and is replaced by Wes Burns.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 21:09 GMT 2-0
 EMIL RIIS! AGAIN!!
 A brilliant cross by Luke Thomas from deep is well met by the Dane. Seven goals in City colours for the striker.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 21:09 GMT Wigan blaze over
 Connor Barrett, a Leicester lad, gets the ball at the back post, but he lashes over.
 25 minutes to go here.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 21:02 GMT Double change
 Cullen and Braybrooke coming on for City.
 They replace Chaplin and Smallbone. It means we'll see Braybrooke slightly deeper.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 21:01 GMT Riis should do better
 Sometimes, you just need to go long and Okoli does.
 The defender's ball beats Wigan's defence and Riis latches onto it. But his effort is poor.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 20:51 GMT O'Hora booked
 City now lead 4-3 in yellow card.
 Warren O'Hora has just been booked.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:47 GMT No changes
 No changes from either side at the break.
 I don't think it'll be long until we see something, especially from Martin.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:33 GMT Half-time
 It's been far from a spectacle but Leicester lead 1-0 thanks to Emil Riis' sixth goal for the club.
 Smallbone, Okoli and Thomas all on yellow cards.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 20:32 GMT Thomas booked
 So silly from Thomas.
 The man beats him and he just hacks him down. No good giving a free-kick there.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:31 GMT Good City move
 Well-worked move ends in Alves chipping the ball into the box and Thomas nearly getting on the end of it.
 We'll have 1 minutes of added time.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:26 GMT Okoli booked
 Fifth yellow card of the evening goes to Caleb Okoli for a foul on Costelloe.
 City caught on counter after Doyle's pass through to Alves was poor.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 20:18 GMT Wigan making a change
 Fox is coming on for Wigan. The visitors making a change early on here.
 Chilokoa-Mullen, who was booked early on, has come off.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:13 GMT City in full flow
 The goal has helped Leicester play with more confidence and they have had 3 chances to stretch their lead.
 Riis nearly scored a replica of his goal from a corner before Thomas' flick nearly gave Doyle the perfect chance. Just now, Doyle nearly curled the ball past Whitworth, but some great defending steered the ball wide.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:06 GMT Lucky to be ahead
 Somehow, Wigan are one-on-one from one ball and Scott Hogan should score.
 However, the experienced striker never looked convincing and McCarthy rescues City.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 20:03 GMT GOALLL
 EMIL RIIS!!!
 The striker at the back post taps in after Caleb Okoli flicks on Will Smallbone's corner. It might be Okoli's though, looks like the ball might have already crossed the line.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:01 GMT Crossbar
 Emil Riis has another opportunity and this time beats Whitworth.
 Okoli threads the ball brilliantly to the striker but he's forced down the right channel. He tries his luck and it deflects on to the crossbar.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 20:00 GMT First shot on target
 Why not? After a bit of a slow start here, Emil Riis has registered the first shot on target.
 He got himself into some space outside the area and tried his luck against Joe Whitworth. Unfortunately, it lacked any conviction.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 19:54 GMT A third yellow card
 Chilokoa-Mullen has been booked.
 We are on three yellow cards inside nine minutes.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 19:52 GMT Smallbone booked
 Silly that is by Will Smallbone.
 He gets beaten and pulls Walsh back by the shirt. He's now on a booking.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 19:50 GMT Early booking
 Reggie Walsh booked for a flying challenge on Will Alves.
 We're 4 minutes in.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 19:47 GMT Kick-off
 We're underway.
 COME ON CITY!
 Comments Josh Holland Today 19:42 GMT Here come the teams
 Conor Chaplin lead the Foxes out as captain.
 We'll have a minutes silence before kick-off tonight.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 19:29 GMT Pre-match huddle done
 The pre-match huddle that is now a matchday ritual within the City camp is done.
 The starting XI have just finished their warm-ups and have moved back into the dressing room. Still plenty of empty seats here inside the King Power Stadium.
 Comments Josh Holland ‌ 
 Today 18:49 GMT Remembering Vichai
 Content cannot be displayed without consent Comments Josh Holland Today 18:37 GMT Two changes from City
 So one forced change and one optional one by Russell Martin this evening. Will Smallbone and Conor Chaplin come into the team this evening in place of John Lundstram [suspended] and Sammy Braybrooke.
 I actually thought we'd see more changes from City tonight. Caleb Okoli starts in defence despite being replaced at half-time at Luton after making a crucial mistake for the goal.
 Comments Josh Holland Today 18:32 GMT How the opponents line-up
 Wigan XI vs City: Whitworth; Barrett, Burns, Carragher, Chilokoa-Mullen; Costelloe, Weir (c), Jensen Walsh, Miller; Burrowes, Hogan.
 Subs: J. Walsh, Fox, Mellish, Higgins, Greenhalgh, Sze, Saydee
 Comments Josh Holland ‌
